flawless: What you destroyed, I brought back. What I destroyed stayed gone.
Paragon means example. Let this one be yours.
solid: You laid my servants low and I raised them up. That is the way of the Paragon.
You wounded my wings. I've returned greater things than wings from the grave.
close: Even my graveyard ran dry at the end. You fought magnificently.
I nearly needed someone to bring me back. Thank the light, I didn't.
